subject.title: [Feature]: Allow telegram groups by creating allowList of users

question: Should OpenClaw add a bundled Telegram `groupPolicy: "members"` mode, and what exact fail-closed membership contract should it use?
rationale: This changes the Telegram group authorization boundary and adds a config value; automation should not choose the security semantics for Bot API failures, membership trust, caching, and non-Telegram behavior.

options.title: Approve fail-closed members policy
options.body: Define a Telegram-only policy that verifies all current group members against trusted numeric IDs and blocks on uncertain membership checks.

options.title: Keep explicit group allowlists
options.body: Decline the bundled policy for now and keep users on explicit group chat allowlists plus community plugin workarounds.

options.title: Prototype behind maintainer review
options.body: Ask for a narrow maintainer-sponsored PR that proves the API behavior and security audit semantics before deciding the final config contract.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed members policy
recommendation.body: Define a Telegram-only policy that verifies all current group members against trusted numeric IDs and blocks on uncertain membership checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided the detailed maintainer-facing review on this security/config boundary and is the highest-confidence decision owner in the inspected evidence.
